newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemen is developing the Jenna oil field's pipelines at a cost of $20 million.
- Dubai is to build an oil refinery at a cost of $400 million.
- Gulf Exhibition 97 starts in Abu Dhabi. Around 120 Arab and international firms are due to participate.
- United Arab Emirates offset scheme set up a leasing firm in Abu Dhabi.
- Saudi chamber of commerce chairman hopes trade between Saudi Arabia and Russia will exceed $170 million.
